_format: skill-creator eval format — see https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/evaluating-skills. Run each prompt in a fresh session with and without the skill; grade the assertions.

evals.prompt: Make a ticket for the flaky deploy pipeline — it failed three times this week on the smoke-test step.
assertions: Resolves the board contract from the consuming repo's AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md first (or runs projects_list and asks which project when absent)
Loads the vikunja MCP tool schemas via ToolSearch before calling them
Writes the description as TipTap HTML, not raw markdown, with the first paragraph in the theme + [P · I · E] format
Applies the label taxonomy: theme/<kebab>, impact/H|M|L, effort/S|M|L, plus needs-refinement for an unrefined ticket
Does not mark the ticket ready — the Definition of Ready has seven sections it cannot yet satisfy

evals.prompt: What should we work on next?
assertions: Reads the board via tasks_list and checks the reported 'Found N' against expected board size (pagination gotcha)
Recommends highest-leverage UNBLOCKED tickets (P-band first, then impact/effort; effort/S unblocked tickets favored)
Uses/curates the do-next label within its hard cap, removing stale picks when adding
Never pads: if nothing genuinely qualifies, says so instead of inventing work

evals.prompt: VIK-42 is done — I merged the fix this morning. Close it out.
assertions: Posts an HTML evidence comment with the commit/PR links before calling task_complete
Verifies against the ticket's own Verification section rather than taking 'done' on faith — or states plainly that verification could not be run
Moves/labels per lifecycle conventions (Review bucket for agent-completed work when the contract says a human accepts)
